name: reauth-gate
title: Reauth Gate
description: Step-up prompt for sensitive actions. Checks a passkey, password or PIN through your own verify function, names the action and why it asks, runs the queued action after confirmation, and remembers it for a short window shown as an endable countdown chip.

meta.stops: Helps prevent a sensitive action on an unattended signed-in screen
meta.summary: Asks the user to re-confirm with a passkey, password or PIN before a sensitive action, so an unattended signed-in screen is harder to misuse.
meta.server: Re-check the credential and a server-side recent-auth timestamp on every sensitive endpoint, and rate-limit verify; the client window is only a convenience.
catches: Sensitive action started without a recent re-confirmation
Names the exact action and the reason before asking
Runs the queued action right after a successful verify
Shows how long the unlock lasts, with a button to end it early
Wrong credential or a rejected verify shows an error and keeps the action queued
limits: The unlock window lives in component state only; a reload, another tab or a direct API call is not covered
Security depends entirely on your verify function and your server
No attempt limit or lockout; rate-limit verification on the server
Passkey mode calls verify with no secret; you run the WebAuthn ceremony inside verify
a11y: Prompt is a labelled region (role=region with aria-labelledby); focus moves to its first control when it opens
Method switch uses aria-pressed buttons in a labelled group
Credential input has a sr-only label, aria-invalid on a wrong attempt, and a polite live message
Countdown chip is role=timer with an aria-label; its progress animation is skipped under reduced motion
